info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Marketing Advertising-spec
info.description: The Marketing Advertising Creation API enables businesses to develop and launch advertising campaigns tailored to their marketing strategies. This API allows marketers to submit campaign specifications, including target demographics, budget allocations, and creative assets. It is particularly useful for marketing teams and advertising agencies looking to automate their campaign creation processes. By providing structured input, users can efficiently set up new advertising initiatives, enhancing the overall effectiveness of their marketing efforts.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and launch a new advertising campaign in the marketing system, enabling targeted outreach to your audience and boosting product visibility.
